notes.title: 🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.04 Update is Live! 🕵️‍♂️
notes.notes:
🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.04 Update is Live!

Exciting new features, refined gameplay mechanics, and a brand-new Prologue await you jump into your island trading adventure anew!


[hr][/hr]


✨ Brand New UI Overhaul
Complete UI Redesign: Every interface has been beautifully redesigned for clarity, ease-of-use, and smooth visual transitions. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/0b63ebcb2c23f953046db3fdbb1565b1540e4a51.png"]

Smooth Scrolling: No more harsh scrolling menus and inventories glide seamlessly for a comfortable browsing experience. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/78715e15b174a8fea62c0f15b90342b5a0a0cee5.png"]

[hr][/hr]


🕵️‍♂️ Watch Out! Thieves on the Island!
New Thief Mechanic: Keep a close eye on your market sneaky thieves 🦹‍♂️ will occasionally attempt to steal your goods! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/894266f731a5475fd15ce97fc155b21717283dfe.png"]

[hr][/hr]


🗑️ Keep Your Island Clean!
Waste Management System: Customers now leave litter behind. Regularly tidy up to maintain a clean, attractive island for your visitors.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/09d7a7c1d72da50a78dd2f62e119b9a6d4fa773a.png"]

[hr][/hr]


⚒️ Workshop System Unlocked!
Craft Unique Products: Combine items to create exciting new products! Start crafting with the Alcohol Distillery 🍾 and Oven 🥖! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/93143dc17a6ecc6f35d59fea2ead2f21dcdc2383.png"]

Engineer’s Shop Now Open: Visit the engineer’s building to buy essential workshop equipment. 

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/084ba496a57aadb5ebf8a4cbc070078a809efc77.png"]
[hr][/hr]


💾 Major Save System Update
Save System Redesigned: We've drastically improved save/load times for better gameplay. 

⚠️ Important: All previous saves have been reset due to this upgrade. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but starting fresh will greatly enhance your experience! 


[hr][/hr]


🎬 New Prologue & Tutorial Videos
Playable Prologue: Experience a short story-driven introduction, perfect for learning game mechanics. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/0250d5370bb9b1ee63fe6bd3b1984d1430b062c7.png"]

Enhanced Tutorials: Quick, clear tutorial videos now accompany new game starts to ensure you dive right into the action.

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/8469a4b2e50f78af257cdfa8e2c8f470ac3add24.png"]

[hr][/hr]


Developer’s Secret Message
“Stay tuned—our next update will bring even more immersive features and additional languages!”


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.3 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.3 Update is Here!We’ve packed this release with clarity, quality-of-life improvements, and fresh content to deepen your island trading experience!


[hr][/hr]


📚 Revamped Tutorial & UI
Complete tutorial overhaul: Every step is now crystal clear, guiding you through planting, harvesting, and trading with on-screen tips and highlights.



Intuitive button states: UI elements instantly show active vs. inactive functions—no more guessing which action you’re about to take.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/99c2f64b8fac48cb0d2f2f956f5605a65d70c062.png"]



[hr][/hr]


🥛 Crate Management & Item Details
Dedicated milk crates: Milk collection crates and empty product crates can now be distinguished.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/46c61c141e827766ad9ee89383f1bbb1ecdbe8cd.png"]

Seed-to-crop tooltips: Hover over any seed to see exactly which crop it grows into and how long it will take.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/85fe8c5f86649d15b4dd94a8b3475da64e427aa6.png"]

 

Rich item HUD: View an item’s name, type, and remaining durability or uses while holding it—no need to open menus.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/230d08a8c54e05df5ddf5e4a1c0356f73fd689d9.png"]




[hr][/hr]

💰 Economy & NPC Overhaul
Auto-pricing system: When you list goods for sale, suggested prices are assigned automatically—just confirm and trade!

 

Three NPC tiers: Rich, Middle-Class, and Poor visitors now have unique names, preferences, and price-acceptance thresholds for a more dynamic market.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/f0334e346ae3594ad09a828829a0ea9a1453478f.png"]

 

Friendly skeleton aide: If your funds drop to zero, sleep peacefully for two days and a helpful skeleton will appear to lend you a hand.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/2a8bee1126c6be561b712c7d65c95b7a0e61934f.png"]   
[hr][/hr]


🚧 Map Collision & Animation Fixes
Smooth map traversal: All collision glitches have been fixed so you can explore beaches and groves without ever getting stuck. 

Faster rotation controls: Shelves, displays, and other placeable objects now rotate more quickly, making setup a breeze. 

Satisfying placement animation: A new spin-and-snap effect adds polish every time you position items. 

Safety confirmations: “Are you sure you want to sleep?” and faction-selection dialogs prevent accidental choices while navigating menus.



[hr][/hr]


🗓️ Calendar & Wayfinding Upgrades
Detailed calendar view: Track day counters, seasonal events, and special festivals right in the pause menu—plan your harvests and sales with confidence.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/e7b918c9c0709435944e630df1b8a69c18a4d3a8.png"] 

Improved navigation markers: Clear signposts and map pins make finding your home, storage, and key stalls effortless. 

Enhanced NPC animations: Watch buyers browse stalls and wait in line with updated, lifelike movements that bring the market to life. 


[hr][/hr]Developer’s Secret Message 
“Coming soon in the v0.5 update: we’ll be available in 11 different languages for our valued players—stay tuned!”


[hr][/hr]
Dive back into Island Market Simulator v0.3 and discover a richer, smoother, and more strategic trading adventure! 🌟

notes.title: 🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.2 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.2 Update is Here!We’re taking a big step forward just before Next Fest! With the v0.2 update, Island Market Simulator now offers a much deeper and more strategic gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:




[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/56e1c2d09a052502fdb643dc90d9653ad58de6c5.png"]



[hr][/hr]📅 Calendar System Added
A brand new calendar is now part of the game! Players can check upcoming seasonal and historical events, plan their product strategies, and manage their stock accordingly. Is a festival coming up? Expect a demand spike—be prepared!





[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/d33b8aecd318d8d33d3efa2b45ac7f9e82534040.png"]





[hr][/hr]🏠 Rent and Profit Balancing
Rent prices have been adjusted, offering a more realistic economic progression as you expand your store.

The profit margins of products like blackberries, milk, and currants have been significantly increased. Selling the right item at the right time is now even more rewarding!



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/e2d6d2a8ffbf11e1e960a1062e6c3a95267ff4f6.png"]



[hr][/hr]📘 Improved Tutorial and Map Enhancements
We’ve made it easier for new players to dive in:

The tutorial has been completely revamped to provide a smoother onboarding experience.

A map has been added to the pause menu, and signposts are now placed around key locations to make exploration more intuitive.



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/4a2eb7c560d1e2f273b75fea3adf14c9797d5799.png"][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/aeae9888ea6f4766d9e65eeda3466cde35c0be81.png"]



[hr][/hr]🧭 More Quest Variety
A wider range of quests is now available, bringing more diverse challenges and stories as you progress in your journey.





[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/6632e6509ac612b1944cd165b44344b244408a2d.png"]



[hr][/hr]🌟 Market Reputation Matters More
Your store’s reputation now has a direct and significant impact on customer demand. A well-respected market attracts more customers and drives more sales!




[hr][/hr]
With this update, Island Market Simulator offers a richer, more immersive experience full of strategic depth.
See you at Next Fest! 🎉
